summary.goal: Inject trail CLI instructions into spawned agent prompts so they can self-record if trail is available.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specialist agent prompts include trail CLI instructions
Forge worker prompts include trail CLI instructions
Instructions are best-effort - no failure if trail unavailable

summary.note: Best-effort. If trail isn't installed or agents don't follow instructions, upstream trajectories still capture the reasoning that matters.

observations: Relay SDK spawn() has no env parameter - can't inject trajectory env vars
Workaround: inject instructions into prompt text
Graceful degradation - doesn't break if trail not installed

steps.title: Add trail instructions to specialist prompt
steps.description: In spawner.ts, add trajectory section to specialist task prompt
